subject: Art and design

source.title: National curriculum in England: art and design programmes of study

coverage.yearStructure: key-stage programme; no statutory year-by-year sequence
coverage.ks4: not applicable; the England National Curriculum art and design programme covers KS1-KS3

statementPolicy: Controlled paraphrases only. Example content in square brackets and other non-statutory material are not represented as statutory objectives.

KS3: History of art, craft, design and architecture

KS1.summary: Use a range of materials creatively to design and make products.
Use drawing, painting and sculpture to develop and communicate ideas, experiences and imagination.
Develop techniques using colour, pattern, texture, line, shape, form and space.
Learn about a range of artists, craft makers and designers, compare practices and disciplines, and connect their work to their own work.

KS2.summary: Develop control and use of materials with creativity, experimentation and increasing awareness of different kinds of art, craft and design.
Create sketchbooks to record observations and use them to review and revisit ideas.
Improve mastery of drawing, painting and sculpture techniques using a range of materials.
Learn about significant artists, architects and designers in history.

KS3.summary: Develop creativity and ideas while increasing proficiency in executing art, craft and design work.
Use varied techniques to record observations and explore ideas through sketchbooks, journals and other media.
Use a range of techniques and media, including painting, and increase proficiency in handling different materials.
Analyse and evaluate pupils' own work and the work of others to strengthen visual impact or application.

KS3.domain: History of art, craft, design and architecture
KS3.summary: Learn about the history of art, craft, design and architecture, including periods, styles and major movements from ancient times to the present.
